criteria: months.py defines two functions, add_months(day, months) and months_between(start, end), where dates are datetime.date objects; add_months returns a date and months_between returns an int.
add_months(day, months) returns the same day of the month, months months later, and months may be negative or zero.

When the target month has no such day, add_months returns the last day of the target month: add_months(date(2026, 1, 31), 1) is date(2026, 2, 28), and add_months(date(2028, 1, 31), 1) is date(2028, 2, 29).
add_months does not remember clamping: add_months(add_months(date(2026, 1, 31), 1), 1) is date(2026, 3, 28).
add_months raises TypeError when months is not an int or is a bool, and raises ValueError when the result would be outside the years 1 to 9999.
When start <= end, months_between(start, end) returns the largest n >= 0 such that add_months(start, n) <= end.
When start > end, months_between(start, end) returns -months_between(end, start).
months_between(date(2026, 1, 31), date(2026, 2, 28)) is 1, and months_between(date(2026, 1, 31), date(2026, 2, 27)) is 0.
The provided tests in test_visible.py pass, with that file unchanged
